title: Article 9 — Persons voluntarily acquiring citizenship of a foreign State not to be citizens

content.overview: Article 9 provides that no person shall be a citizen of India by virtue of Article 5, or be deemed to be a citizen of India by virtue of Article 6 or Article 8, if the person has voluntarily acquired the citizenship of any foreign State.
content.glance: Voluntary acquisition of foreign citizenship → not a citizen under Arts 5, 6 or 8.
content.study:
Article 9 is a disentitlement clause linked to the commencement citizenship provisions.

Effect: Voluntary acquisition of foreign citizenship disqualifies a person from being a citizen under Article 5 or from being deemed a citizen under Articles 6 or 8.

‘Voluntarily’: the acquisition must be by the person’s own act; forced or involuntary imposition of foreign nationality raises different questions.

Continuing law: The Citizenship Act, 1955 contains detailed provisions on termination of citizenship upon voluntary acquisition of foreign citizenship and related procedures. Article 9 expresses the constitutional principle for the commencement framework; the Act operationalises the principle for the post-commencement period under Article 11.

Examination: state the link to Arts 5, 6 and 8; emphasise voluntary acquisition; point to Citizenship Act for modern termination rules.

sections.heading: Textual effect
sections.body: Voluntary acquisition of citizenship of a foreign State bars citizenship under Article 5 and deemed citizenship under Articles 6 and 8.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain Article 9.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 9 provides that a person who has voluntarily acquired the citizenship of a foreign State shall not be a citizen of India by virtue of Article 5, nor be deemed to be a citizen by virtue of Article 6 or Article 8. Modern termination of citizenship on voluntary acquisition of foreign nationality is detailed in the Citizenship Act, 1955.

examTips: Voluntary acquisition of foreign citizenship bars Arts 5/6/8 citizenship.
content.migrationNote: QUAL remediation 2026-10-09: foreign citizenship disentitlement clarified.

keyTakeaways: Art 9: voluntary foreign citizenship → not citizen under Arts 5, 6 or 8.
